SELECT r.id AS memory_id, r.member_id AS author_id, m.nickname AS author_nickname, s.id AS spot_id, s.name AS spot_name, r.latitude AS latitude, r.longitude AS longitude, r.visited_date AS visited_date, r.nights AS nights, r.content AS content, r.visibility AS visibility, r.status AS status, r.created_at AS created_at, r.updated_at AS updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_like l WHERE l.memory_id = r.id) AS like_count,
FROM memory r JOIN member m ON m.id = r.member_id LEFT JOIN spot s ON s.id = r.spot_id AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE r.id = #{memoryId}

choose.when: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory_like lk WHERE lk.memory_id = r.id AND lk.member_id = #{viewerId}) AS liked_by_me

mapper.sql: (SELECT COALESCE(i.thumbnail_object_key, i.object_key) FROM memory_image i WHERE i.memory_id = r.id ORDER BY i.display_order LIMIT 1) AS thumbnail_key, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_image i2 WHERE i2.memory_id = r.id) AS image_count
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS memory_id, r.member_id AS author_id, m.nickname AS author_nickname, s.id AS spot_id, s.name AS spot_name, r.latitude AS latitude, r.longitude AS longitude, r.visited_date AS visited_date, r.nights AS nights, LEFT(r.content, 100) AS excerpt, , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_like l WHERE l.memory_id = r.id) AS like_count, , r.created_at AS created_at FROM memory r JOIN member m ON m.id = r.member_id LEFT JOIN spot s ON s.id = r.spot_id AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE r.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member WHERE id = #{memberId} AND status <> 'WITHDRAWN')
